policy.postprocessing: bilinear logits at bounded processing_size; nearest labels and bilinear water-family posterior to original size; pixel confidence gate; 8-connected components; actual pixel-area gate; no fill/dilation

protocol: All eight catalog originals, complete videos without frame sampling; frozen image detector plus separately versioned video-only temporal water confirmation. Original media and image thresholds remain unchanged.
note: Known regression/adaptation files, not independent accuracy. Catalog tags describe subjects, not ground truth. Missing subject classes and unexpected predictions need visual review; no precision/recall/mAP is inferred. Animal/residue tracker IDs need not represent distinct objects; water counts are simultaneous visual regions, not distinct puddles.

items.visual_review: Água real marcada em139/240quadros; nos instantes0e11,95s a marcação acompanha o escoamento, mas falta aos6s. Dez IDs de resíduos não são dez objetos: vários repetem o mesmo pequeno resíduo branco à esquerda; três representantes marcam um ponto da tubulação fixa e são falsos positivos de resíduo nesta revisão.
A foto permanece sem marcações, apesar dos sacos e embalagens visíveis junto à grelha. Falha de detecção preservada e documentada; não é acerto de cena limpa.

Quatro embalagens reais e duas regiões de água/reflexo são destacadas. Máscara acompanha a superfície em torno dos resíduos e a região refletida superior direita; caixas são envelopes e não quatro itens removíveis ou duas poças fisicamente independentes.

video_only_confirmation_note: Temporal engineering policy added after the image-profile independent evaluation, not a retuning of image thresholds. Require longest consecutive water-presence run >=ceil(fps*0.5); otherwise suppress all water in the video while preserving raw proposals and reconstructing from original frames. This can suppress genuine very brief water and does not guarantee removal of all local blips when another persistent water sequence exists.

hanoi_raw_blur_water.review: Seven raw blur-related water proposals preserved for audit; none displayed after video-only confirmation. Original raw validation remains unchanged.

sarjeta_fixed_pipe_as_residue.review: Three representative tracker IDs are on the same fixed pipe/outlet area, not loose residue; false residue alerts in sampled representatives.

conclusion: All eight originals process and play correctly. Images retain frozen profile1314; videos use separately versioned temporal profile4d613. Hanoi unsupported brief water is removed from displayed output, with unchanged animal/residue proposals. Water/rat improvements coexist with difficult-rat/litter misses, intermittent water and pipe false alerts. No image/test policy was changed.
